A. 亚热带季风气候和温带季风气候
B. 水田农业和旱地农业
C. 农耕区和牧业区
D. 湿润地区与半湿润地区

We need final line format 答案：[LETTER]. Need think carefully. Qinling-Huaihe line is important: subtropical vs temperate monsoon? Yes roughly 1月0℃等温线, 800mm等降水量线, subtropics vs north temperate, humid vs semi-humid, paddy vs dryland, etc. Not boundary for farming area and pastoral area. Chinese agricultural regions: farming area vs pastoral area roughly 400mm isohyet, from Great Khingan - Yinshan - Bashang - Qinling? Need check: The boundary between农耕区 and牧区 is 400 mm annual precipitation line? The line from 大兴安岭—阴山—贺兰山—祁连山—? Actually the 400 mm isohyet separates farming and animal husbandry in China (eastern monsoon agricultural region vs northwest pastoral). Qinling-Huaihe not. So answer C.

content:
秦岭—淮河一线是我国亚热带季风气候与温带季风气候、水田农业与旱地农业、湿润地区与半湿润地区的重要分界线，但不是农耕区与牧业区的分界线。农耕区与牧业区的分界线大致与400毫米年等降水量线接近。

答案：C
